title: Frog in Cosmic Bubble
description: A vibrant green frog with large purple eyes floats mid-air inside a transparent spherical bubble. The surreal scene contains two floating crystalline islands with purple and cyan textures, a large yellow moon, glowing purple energy tendrils, and scattered neon orbs against a black cosmic background.
prompt: A luminous green tree frog with glowing purple eyes floats inside a large transparent bubble. Inside the bubble are two levitating crystalline rock formations with dripping icicles in shades of purple and cyan, a large yellow moon in the background, bright purple energy lightning bolts, and floating neon orbs. The entire scene is set against a deep black void with subtle purple nebulae, highly detailed digital fantasy art.
